name: Tapuziel
install: bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm install 24 && nvm alias default 24 && export PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which 24)"):$PATH" && node --version && npm ci'

terminals.name: tapuz-server
terminals.command: bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && export PATH="$(dirname "$(nvm which 24)"):$PATH" && node --version && exec node src/server.js'
terminals.description: Tapuziel CMS (Express + SQLite) on http://localhost:3000/admin. First run seeds the DB; run `npm run seed:admin` for a dev admin/admin login.
